config.selection: maximum validation AUROC; single-class validation negative logloss; exact ties smaller C
config.final_fit: selected train-fitted model; no train+validation refit
config.weighting: equal person base weight then class balance; training-prior logit correction
config.native_score_direction: higher score is greater warning risk; never selected from validation or test

mmdev.adaptation: past-only median-filled ISOMAP/S-map, daily32 history and24 local window, E1..6; retain undefined scores as NaN

config.threshold: linear90th percentile of finite validation negative scores; test alerts use strictly greater than threshold
config.zero_shot: frozen earlier Humans source risk mappings; no new-cohort model training or C selection; P90 threshold calibration uses new-cohort validation negatives
config.common_population: intersection of finite scores across every method managed by this runner
config.within_person_definition: equal-person mean AUROC among people with both classes
config.secondary_comparison: All target-trained methods are separate from frozen human-source transfer

data_mapping.exclude_mission3: Original benchmark excludes it from algorithm comparison
data_mapping.state: All numeric Target=YES channels; hourly observed means, then daily mean and population SD
data_mapping.family: Published Subsystem metadata; both daily summaries retain the same family
data_mapping.context: All numeric Target=NO channels as daily means; four daily telecommand execution counts by Priority=0,1,2,3
data_mapping.categorical_channels: Excluded from numerical fluctuation states and numerical context
data_mapping.command_count: Count original event rows; no execution in a complete log interval is zero
data_mapping.resampling: Left-closed hourly bins, then daily; no interpolation or forward fill
data_mapping.state_feature_budget: Existing select_reference_channels, budget32, same rule across cohorts
data_mapping.clock: Published anonymized clock: time scaled by an undisclosed factor above 1; reported days are anonymized units
data_mapping.temporal_split_origin_rule: Training future_end_date precedes train_end; validation issue_time is at/after train_end and future_end precedes validation_end; test issue_time is at/after validation_end

endpoint.reason: Fixed initial-reference fluctuation endpoint yields zero normal-start origins on Mission1 training/validation; retain that result and evaluate the independent expert endpoint separately
endpoint.event_start: Earliest annotated channel start for the same event ID
endpoint.event_end: Latest annotated channel end for the same event ID
endpoint.issue_time: Midnight after completed origin day d
endpoint.negative: No expert anomaly onset of any dimensionality/length in the future interval; complete annotated followup
endpoint.other_anomaly: Future univariate or point anomaly without a selected multivariate subsequence event is excluded from the negative class
endpoint.rare_event: Author Category=Rare Event remains a benign event; report its future-window false-positive rate separately
endpoint.reference_and_features: Unchanged HNE personal-prefix normalization, channel-budget selection, Sampling.daily, all296 coordinates, observed-only telemetry and executed-command context
endpoint.time_split: Same original ESA half-time split and final three training months for validation
endpoint.test_status: Protocol fixed from training/validation annotation taxonomy and coverage; test outcomes not constructed
endpoint.units: All periods use anonymized published clock units; not physical days

data_mapping.primary_comparison: HNE source model frozen from RESILIENT+BrisT1D, compared with its history-only source model and DNB on each mission
data_mapping.secondary_comparison: Target-trained models use the same temporal train/validation boundaries and fixed HNE core

public_baselines.phase: target-domain training; separate from human-only source transfer

data_mapping.statistical_unit: Temporal blocks within each mission; report each mission separately, do not treat days as independent spacecraft
